summary: Gauzy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a proposed debt settlement under Israeli insolvency law (Sections 322–348) to avoid formal proceedings. The settlement offers 100% repayment of senior secured claims via two tracks: full repayment upon an exit event >$330M, or 25% of annual net profit if profitable earlier. A $7M PIPE financing led by CEO Eyal Peso and Chutzpah Holdings LP is contingent on creditor and court approval. Creditor voting requires >51% by number and >75% by value. Watch for creditor vote outcome and court confirmation timeline; failure could lead to formal insolvency.
